_about: GENERATED from RFI canon by tools/convert-5e.mjs (rubric v1.10.0) — do not hand-edit; put fixes in content/overrides/manifestations.json. The starter-kit manifestations as ordinary dnd5e slot spells (pack spells) with the class lists they join; Doctrine signatures are Path-locked (flags.bad-eden-5e.requiresPath).

spells.name: Already Ducked
spells.description:
You watch the next second arrive a second early and lend it to whoever needs it. By the time the swing exists, its target already isn't there.

You or one ally within range gains a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

Path of the Wyrdlens Adept only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Wyrdlens Adept can learn or prepare it.

Mal: 'Dodging is for people who wait until it happens. Amateurs.'

spells.name: Amicus Brief
spells.description:
You file a friend-of-the-court brief on an ally's behalf: history itself weighs in, noting that people like them have prevailed before.

One ally within range gains a +1 bonus to AC, +1 bonus to Wisdom and Charisma saving throws for the duration.

Path of the Pactkeeper only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Pactkeeper can learn or prepare it.

Mal: 'It's a hug, but citable.'

spells.name: Angle of Witness
spells.description:
Everything impossible is only impossible from most angles. You hold open the one angle from which the target can absolutely, definitely, be hit.

One creature you can see within range gains a −2 penalty to AC for the duration.

From the Path of the Wyrdlens Adept.

Mal: 'There's always a spot where the untouchable guy is just a guy. It's usually behind the ego.'

spells.name: Atlas Prism
spells.description:
A palm-sized prism that carries the weight of the world one refraction at a time — you aim it at someone and the incoming harm bends around their edges.

One ally within range gains a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

Path of the Wyrdlens Adept only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Wyrdlens Adept can learn or prepare it.

Mal: 'It doesn't stop the hit. It just files it under someone with broader shoulders. The prism has VERY broad shoulders.'

spells.name: Bind Witness
spells.description:
You swear the target in. Whatever they do next is testimony, and the record does not permit evasive action.

One creature you can see within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it is charmed, and it must spend its action each turn on what the spell demands for the duration.

At the end of each of its turns, an affected creature repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Path of the Pactkeeper only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Pactkeeper can learn or prepare it.

Mal: 'Do you swear to tell the truth? Doesn't matter. The paperwork already assumed you would.'

spells.name: Borrowed Face
spells.description:
You reach into the crowd of selves you've dreamed being and put one on. It fits. It always fits. That's the unsettling part.

You gain a +1 bonus to AC for the duration.

Path of the Dreamwalker only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Dreamwalker can learn or prepare it.

Mal: 'Today she's a customs inspector named Doreen. Doreen has a lanyard. You don't argue with a lanyard.'

spells.name: Breath Before the Cut
spells.description:
You put on the stillness like a coat. Your pulse does not rise. Your blade does not hurry. It doesn't have to.

You gain a +1 bonus to AC, +1 to initiative for the duration.

Path of the Aurablade only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Aurablade can learn or prepare it.

Mal: Everyone else brought adrenaline. You brought punctuality.

spells.name: Cadence Standard
spells.description:
A marching cadence that keeps counting whether or not anyone is marching. The line holds to the beat.

Each creature of your choice in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within range gains a +2 bonus to Wisdom and Charisma saving throws for the duration.

Path of the Harmony Marshal only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Harmony Marshal can learn or prepare it.

Mal: Left. Left. Left, right, left. Congratulations: you are now unbreakable, and slightly annoying.

spells.name: Carry-the-Unsayable
spells.description:
You open your mouth and let out the part of last night's dream that language refuses to hold. Everyone nearby catches a piece of it.

Each creature of your choice in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 1d4 psychic damage and is frightened until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and suffers no other effect.

From the Path of the Dreamwalker.

Mal: 'There's no word for it. That's the problem. Now it's THEIR problem.'

spells.name: Citation Needed
spells.description:
A glowing bracketed tag hangs over the target's head, flagging their entire posture as an unsupported claim. Everyone can see it. Everyone judges.

One creature you can see within range gains a −2 penalty to Wisdom and Charisma saving throws for the duration.

Path of the Cosmic Linguist only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Cosmic Linguist can learn or prepare it.

Mal: 'Their whole personality just got flagged for review. I've been saying this for years.'

spells.name: Cite Precedent
spells.description:
You cite the prior case — the one where this exact fight already happened and everyone regretted it. The precedent is binding.

One creature you can see within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it is charmed (it can't willingly take violent action) for the duration.

At the end of each of its turns, an affected creature repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

From the Path of the Pactkeeper.

Mal: 'See Everybody v. Everybody, ruling: knock it off. Upheld on appeal.'

spells.name: Clause Lantern
spells.description:
A lantern that burns the terms of every deal in the room. Hidden costs curl up out of it as smoke, in a legible font.

Each creature of your choice in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it is frightened for the duration.

From the Path of the Pactkeeper.

Mal: 'Ambiance AND discovery. Every restaurant should have one. No restaurant would survive one.'

spells.name: Committee of Me
spells.description:
For one breath, every you that you have ever dreamed of being stands up at once. There are a lot of you. Some are waving.

Each creature of your choice in a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it is staggered: its speed is halved and it has a −2 penalty to attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

Path of the Dreamwalker only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Dreamwalker can learn or prepare it.

Mal: 'Quorum reached. Motion to be unhittable carries, eleven to zero, all in favor being her.'

spells.name: Correspondence Strike
spells.description:
As above, so below; as the bottle you just cracked, so the knee of the man holding it. You break the small thing and the big thing agrees.

One creature you can see within range must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 1d6 lightning damage and is staggered: its speed is halved and it has a −2 penalty to attack rolls until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and suffers no other effect.

From the Path of the Wyrdlens Adept.

Mal: 'Sympathy is a beautiful force of cosmic unity. Also you can hit a guy with it.'

spells.name: Court of Seven
spells.description:
Seven empty chairs assemble around the target area. Whoever sits in them is unclear. That they are presiding is not.

Each creature of your choice in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it is charmed, and it must spend its action each turn on what the spell demands for the duration.

At the end of each of its turns, an affected creature repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Path of the Pactkeeper only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Pactkeeper can learn or prepare it.

Mal: 'You are now in session. All rise. Yes, mid-gunfight. The court has seen worse dockets.'

spells.name: Covenant Hearth
spells.description:
You kindle the old agreement — the one where a fire means everyone around it is, for now, one household. The warmth has terms, and the terms hold.

Each creature of your choice in a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within range gains a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

Path of the Pactkeeper only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Pactkeeper can learn or prepare it.

Mal: 'Home is where somebody signed for you. This counts. It's small, but it counts.'

spells.name: Deposition Lens
spells.description:
A monocle-sized lens on a brass stalk. Whoever you study through it finds that lying has developed a paperwork problem.

One creature you can see within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it is charmed, and it must spend its action each turn on what the spell demands for the duration.

At the end of each of its turns, an affected creature repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Path of the Wyrdlens Adept only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Wyrdlens Adept can learn or prepare it.

Mal: 'Sworn testimony, except the oath is physics.'

spells.name: Doorframe Discount
spells.description:
All doorways are the same doorway if you fell asleep in enough of them. Step into any opening; step out of another one nearby.

You gain a +1 bonus to AC for the duration.

Path of the Dreamwalker only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Dreamwalker can learn or prepare it.

Mal: 'Doors are a franchise. She has the loyalty card.'

spells.name: Dream-Twin
spells.description:
You dream a twin for an ally and set it half a step to their left, where the bullet was going to be.

One ally within range gains a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

From the Path of the Dreamwalker.

Mal: 'Best bodyguard in Bad Eden. Doesn't eat, doesn't sleep, technically IS sleep.'

spells.name: Errata Slip
spells.description:
You issue a small official correction to an ally: 'For "doomed," read "fine."' Reality, sheepish about the typo, complies.

One ally within range gains a +1 bonus to AC, +1 bonus to Wisdom and Charisma saving throws for the duration.

Path of the Cosmic Linguist only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Cosmic Linguist can learn or prepare it.

Mal: 'The previous edition of you contained errors. This one's been fixed. Mostly.'

spells.name: Everyone Gets A Chair
spells.description:
A chair that wasn't there, and now insists. Negotiation begins whether or not anyone scheduled it.

One creature you can see within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it is charmed, and it must spend its action each turn on what the spell demands for the duration.

At the end of each of its turns, an affected creature repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Path of the Harmony Marshal only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Harmony Marshal can learn or prepare it.

Mal: You can't stay mad in a chair with lumbar support. This is documented.

spells.name: Footnote
spells.description:
A tiny superscript numeral appears over the target's head. They become unbearably aware there is a note about them, at the bottom, in smaller print.

One creature you can see within range must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 1d4 psychic damage and is frightened until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and suffers no other effect.

From the Path of the Cosmic Linguist.

Mal: 'Nobody reads the footnotes. That's what makes them load-bearing.'

spells.name: Freeze Assets
spells.description:
Pending review, the target's assets are frozen. All of them. Including the arms and legs, which are, technically, assets.

One creature you can see within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it is restrained until the end of its next turn.

Path of the Pactkeeper only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Pactkeeper can learn or prepare it.

Mal: 'Your account has been locked for suspicious activity. The suspicious activity was "charging at the Pactkeeper."'

spells.name: Hearth-Nail Covenant
spells.description:
Drive one true nail into a room and it becomes a place. Places hold together — including the people in them.

Each creature of your choice in a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within range gains a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

From the Path of the Soul-Smith.

Mal: Home is where somebody hammered a nail in on purpose. That's it. That's the whole secret.

spells.name: Heavily Redacted
spells.description:
You strike sensitive details from an ally's public record: outline, heading, current position. Onlookers get the gist and nothing actionable.

You or one ally within range gains a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

Path of the Cosmic Linguist only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Cosmic Linguist can learn or prepare it.

Mal: 'Witness protection, but for your silhouette.'

spells.name: Hymn of the Open Vein
spells.description:
The old war-hymn only sings in a voice that's bleeding. You provide the voice. It provides everything else.

You gain a +2 bonus to Wisdom and Charisma saving throws for the duration.

Path of the Aurablade only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Aurablade can learn or prepare it.

Mal: All the best songs cost somebody something. This one just skips the middleman.

spells.name: Hypnagogic Shrug
spells.description:
You gift one enemy the 3 p.m. feeling. The full-body head-nod. The where-was-I. Mid-swing, if you time it right.

One creature you can see within range must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, it is staggered: its speed is halved and it has a −2 penalty to attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

From the Path of the Dreamwalker.

Mal: 'Everybody's fought a war on six hours of sleep. Now they're fighting yours on none.'

spells.name: Impossible Second Self
spells.description:
A dream-double peels off and keeps you company — scouting corners, standing in doorways, being the you that gets shot at first.

You gain a +1 bonus to AC, +1 to initiative for the duration.

From the Path of the Dreamwalker.

Mal: 'Two of you. Because the universe looked at one and said, sure, why not, double it.'

spells.name: Italic Emphasis
spells.description:
You set yourself in italics. Everything you say and do leans forward slightly, and the world takes it as intended.

You or one ally within range gains a +2 bonus to Wisdom and Charisma saving throws for the duration.

From the Path of the Cosmic Linguist.

Mal: 'You can tell they mean it. Typographically.'

spells.name: Keystone Verdict
spells.description:
Every structure has the one brick holding the argument together. You circle it in chalk that was never chalk.

One creature you can see within range takes 1d6 force damage.

The target also has a −2 penalty to AC for the duration.

Path of the Bulwark only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Bulwark can learn or prepare it.

Mal: Everything is load-bearing if you're honest about it. Most people aren't. Walls never are.

spells.name: Latchkey Lullaby
spells.description:
A small blue key that exists because you dreamed you owned it. It opens any lock that is, at that moment, asleep — and most locks are always asleep.

Bound tool: once per short rest, open one mundane lock, latch, or seal by singing it three descending notes. Wards, alarms, and anything actively watched are beyond it.

Path of the Dreamwalker only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Dreamwalker can learn or prepare it.

Mal: 'Every lock dreams of being a door. This key is deeply unethical about that.'

spells.name: Lensing
spells.description:
You fold every stray glance in the room through one lens and focus it on a single point behind the target's eyes.

One creature you can see within range must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 1d4 psychic damage and is frightened until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and suffers no other effect.

From the Path of the Wyrdlens Adept.

Mal: 'Kid used to fry ants. Now the ants are existential and the magnifying glass is everyone's attention.'

spells.name: Living Glossary
spells.description:
A small floating book follows you and loudly defines every term your enemy uses. It has opinions about their word choices. It cites sources.

One creature you can see within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it is charmed, and it must spend its action each turn on what the spell demands for the duration.

At the end of each of its turns, an affected creature repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

From the Path of the Cosmic Linguist.

Mal: '"Ambush, noun: see also — oh, they're already mad. Good, it's working."'

spells.name: Long Ledger
spells.description:
You open the ledger — the long one — and read the target's running balance aloud. Every favor taken, every kindness unpaid, itemized, with interest.

One creature you can see within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it is frightened until the end of its next turn.

From the Path of the Pactkeeper.

Mal: 'Everybody's fine with karma until it shows up with line items.'

spells.name: Lucid Standard
spells.description:
Plant the standard and keep watch. Under your sightline, an ally is very hard to surprise, because you already weren't.

One ally within range gains a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

Path of the Harmony Marshal only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Harmony Marshal can learn or prepare it.

Mal: Being watched by someone who likes you: statistically the best armor nobody sells.

spells.name: Margin Note: Not Yet
spells.description:
You jot a small editorial note in the air beside an event that is happening too soon. The universe, embarrassed, agrees to circle back.

One creature you can see within range must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, it is staggered: its speed is halved and it has a −2 penalty to attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

From the Path of the Cosmic Linguist.

Mal: 'The cosmos respects exactly one thing, and it's a correction politely worded.'

spells.name: Marginalia Drift
spells.description:
Your accumulated margin-notes peel off their pages and swarm the target, cross-referencing them into place. Asterisks around the ankles. Daggers at the cuffs.

One creature you can see within range must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it is restrained until the end of its next turn.

Path of the Cosmic Linguist only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Cosmic Linguist can learn or prepare it.

Mal: 'Death by a thousand annotations. Well. Inconvenience by forty of them.'

spells.name: Marshal's Mantle
spells.description:
A mantle of visible jurisdiction. People can tell you're the adult in the room. So can the room.

You gain a +1 bonus to AC, +1 bonus to Wisdom and Charisma saving throws for the duration.

From the Path of the Harmony Marshal.

Mal: Authority is 90% posture, 9% laundry, and 1% cosmic mandate. The mantle handles the laundry.

spells.name: Measured Breath Accord
spells.description:
The room is set to one lawful breath. Chaos may proceed, but it pays rent, in advance, at the counter.

Each creature of your choice in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it is charmed (it can't willingly take violent action) for the duration.

At the end of each of its turns, an affected creature repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

From the Path of the Harmony Marshal.

Mal: In, two three four. Out, two three four. Riots are just breathing that got ahead of itself.

spells.name: Mutual Aid Clause
spells.description:
You invoke the clause every real community keeps in force: when one of ours is in trouble, the neighbors show up. Briefly, invisibly, they do.

One ally within range gains a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

Path of the Pactkeeper only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Pactkeeper can learn or prepare it.

Mal: 'Forty invisible casseroles and a guy with a truck. You cannot buy this coverage.'

spells.name: Passphrase: Please
spells.description:
The courtesy every door was raised on, spoken in the old tongue. Doorkeepers remember their manners. So do locks.

One creature you can see within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it is charmed until the end of its next turn.

Path of the Shadow Courier only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Shadow Courier can learn or prepare it.

Mal: 'Please' is a skeleton key. Mal has been saying this for nine hundred years. Nobody writes it down.

spells.name: Penalty Clause
spells.description:
The target broke a promise — to you, to someone, to themselves; there's always one. You invoke the fine print, and the breach collects.

One creature you can see within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 1d6 qliphothic damage and is frightened until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and suffers no other effect.

From the Path of the Pactkeeper.

Mal: 'Nobody reads section 12(b). Section 12(b) reads YOU.'

spells.name: Pressure Front
spells.description:
You carry the exact moment an avalanche decides. Point it somewhere.

Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 1d6 force damage and is knocked prone. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and suffers no other effect.

Path of the Bulwark only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Bulwark can learn or prepare it.

Mal: Snow doesn't hate anyone. That's what makes it so good at this.

spells.name: Pulled Punch Postulate
spells.description:
You refract one enemy's violence through the kindest available version of them. The swing arrives as a hesitation.

One creature you can see within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it is charmed (it can't willingly take violent action) for the duration.

At the end of each of its turns, an affected creature repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Path of the Wyrdlens Adept only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Wyrdlens Adept can learn or prepare it.

Mal: 'Somewhere in there is the guy who feeds a stray cat. The lens just gives him the wheel for a minute.'

spells.name: Redacted
spells.description:
A crisp black bar stamps itself across the target's eyes. Their view of the scene is now classified above their clearance.

One creature you can see within range must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, it is blinded until the end of its next turn.

Path of the Cosmic Linguist only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Cosmic Linguist can learn or prepare it.

Mal: 'They can appeal the redaction in writing. Processing time: one round. Convenient.'

spells.name: Reliquary Vow
spells.description:
Salvage something broken — a hinge, a locket, a promise — and bind a vow into it. It is now a relic. Relics keep their people.

One ally within range gains a +2 bonus to Wisdom and Charisma saving throws for the duration.

Path of the Soul-Smith only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Soul-Smith can learn or prepare it.

Mal: One man's trash is another man's holy artifact with a warranty written in oath-language.

spells.name: Repaired Memory
spells.description:
Take one of their good memories — a birthday that went fine, a door held open — and forge it into plate. Hammered light, worn as armor.

One ally within range gains a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

Path of the Soul-Smith only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Soul-Smith can learn or prepare it.

Mal: Nostalgia, but load-rated.

spells.name: Sanction Protocol
spells.description:
You flag the target's defenses as non-compliant. Findings are published immediately. Their armor develops an audit trail, and the audit trail has gaps.

One creature you can see within range must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 1d4 psychic damage.

The target also has a −2 penalty to AC for the duration.

Path of the Pactkeeper only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Pactkeeper can learn or prepare it.

Mal: 'Turns out the breastplate was expensed under "miscellaneous." Denied.'

spells.name: Siesta Sanctum
spells.description:
A pocket of golden afternoon settles over your people — hammock light, porch warmth, the certainty that nothing bad happens before dinner.

Each creature of your choice in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within range gains a +1 bonus to AC, +1 bonus to Wisdom and Charisma saving throws for the duration.

Path of the Dreamwalker only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Dreamwalker can learn or prepare it.

Mal: 'Somewhere it's always 2 p.m. on a Sunday. She just brings it to the gunfight.'

spells.name: Sigil of Seeing
spells.description:
A small mark over an ally's brow that shows them the half-second ahead of now — where the punch starts, when the door opens.

One creature you can see within range gains a +1 bonus to AC, +1 to initiative for the duration.

Path of the Wyrdlens Adept only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Wyrdlens Adept can learn or prepare it.

Mal: 'A little eye that watches the future so yours can watch the road. Everyone needs a hobby.'

spells.name: Signed On Delivery
spells.description:
Declare the parcel — object, message, or person under escort — and the route itself countersigns. The route wants what you're carrying to arrive.

You gain a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

Path of the Shadow Courier only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Shadow Courier can learn or prepare it.

Mal: The route cares about the package arriving. Whether YOU arrive is a separate line item.

spells.name: Sleep-Loop
spells.description:
You hand the target the same ten seconds of a very pleasant dream, on repeat. They keep almost finishing it. It keeps almost being finished.

One creature you can see within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it is charmed for the duration.

At the end of each of its turns, an affected creature repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

From the Path of the Dreamwalker.

Mal: 'It's the one where their teeth aren't falling out and everyone claps. Of course they went back in.'

spells.name: Spoiler Alert
spells.description:
You read the target's next move off the wyrd and announce it to the room, loudly, with commentary, before they do it.

One creature you can see within range must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, it is staggered: its speed is halved and it has a −2 penalty to attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

From the Path of the Wyrdlens Adept.

Mal: 'He was going to feint left. Everyone knows he was going to feint left. He knows everyone knows. Watch him not.'

spells.name: Standing Oath
spells.description:
You renew a promise you have never broken and wear it like a coat. It has weathered worse than today.

You or one ally within range gains a +2 bonus to Wisdom and Charisma saving throws for the duration.

From the Path of the Pactkeeper.

Mal: 'Some armor is riveted. Some is just a sentence somebody refused to take back.'

spells.name: Strikethrough
spells.description:
You draw one clean horizontal line through a word the target was standing on — 'inevitable,' usually. The sentence sags.

One creature you can see within range must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 1d6 psychic damage and is frightened until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and suffers no other effect.

From the Path of the Cosmic Linguist.

Mal: 'It's still legible under the line. That's the cruel part. They can see what they used to mean.'

spells.name: The Delete Key
spells.description:
You select one word the target was using — 'confidence' is popular — and press delete. They feel it go.

One creature you can see within range must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 1d6 psychic damage and is frightened until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and suffers no other effect.

Path of the Cosmic Linguist only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Cosmic Linguist can learn or prepare it.

Mal: 'No, it's not in the trash. The trash is a mercy. This was Shift-Delete.'

spells.name: The Good Dream
spells.description:
You slip an ally thirty seconds of the good one — the flying one, the one where the dog is still alive — and they come back steadier.

One creature you can see within range gains a +2 bonus to Wisdom and Charisma saving throws for the duration.

Path of the Dreamwalker only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Dreamwalker can learn or prepare it.

Mal: 'Thirty seconds of the dream where it all worked out. Non-refundable. Extremely effective.'

spells.name: The Ground Remembers You
spells.description:
You introduce yourself to the bedrock, formally, once. After that it counts you as terrain.

You gain a +1 bonus to AC, +1 bonus to Wisdom and Charisma saving throws for the duration.

Path of the Bulwark only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Bulwark can learn or prepare it.

Mal: Mountains don't win arguments. They just outlast everyone who had one.

spells.name: The Kind Angle
spells.description:
You show an ally themselves from the one angle where they're already the person who survives this. Light does the rest.

One ally within range gains a +1 bonus to AC, +1 bonus to Wisdom and Charisma saving throws for the duration.

Path of the Wyrdlens Adept only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Wyrdlens Adept can learn or prepare it.

Mal: 'Everyone has a good side. Hers can stop shrapnel.'

spells.name: The Real Shape
spells.description:
You show one enemy the exact shape of what they are, uncropped, unfiltered, with the lighting they've been avoiding since the war.

One creature you can see within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 1d6 psychic damage and is frightened until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and suffers no other effect.

Path of the Wyrdlens Adept only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Wyrdlens Adept can learn or prepare it.

Mal: 'The truth doesn't hurt. THIS truth hurts. There's a difference and it's 1d6.'

spells.name: The Record Shows
spells.description:
You enter the target's position into the record — location, stance, habits, tells. The record is public. The record updates in real time.

One creature you can see within range gains a −2 penalty to AC for the duration.

Path of the Pactkeeper only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Pactkeeper can learn or prepare it.

Mal: 'Hard to dodge when your dodge is pre-registered. With diagrams.'

spells.name: The Unlisted Stair
spells.description:
A service stairwell that isn't on anyone's plans, connecting here to there. Management doesn't know about it. Management never will.

Sustained gate: a stair connects your position to a spot within 30 feet — across a gap, up a wall, past a barrier. You (and one guest you lead) may climb it; it declines to exist for anyone else.

Path of the Shadow Courier only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Shadow Courier can learn or prepare it.

Mal: Every building has one stairwell management doesn't know about. Every building. Yes, that one. Especially that one.

spells.name: The Unstitching
spells.description:
The Void Edge doesn't cut things. It cuts the stitch between things — a target and the certainty it was leaning on.

One creature you can see within range takes 1d4 psychic damage.

The target also has a −2 penalty to Wisdom and Charisma saving throws for the duration.

Path of the Aurablade only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Aurablade can learn or prepare it.

Mal: Everything is attached to something. Mal recommends not asking what YOU'RE attached to. Too late.

spells.name: The Weight Of The World
spells.description:
For one second, the target carries the weight of the world. Not the planet — the idiom. It is heavier.

One creature you can see within range must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 1d6 psychic damage and is staggered: its speed is halved and it has a −2 penalty to attack rolls until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and suffers no other effect.

Path of the Cosmic Linguist only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Cosmic Linguist can learn or prepare it.

Mal: 'Atlas shrugged. This guy buckled. There's a lesson in there about stretching first.'

spells.name: Thick Skin, Literally
spells.description:
You compliment an ally on being thick-skinned, and the metaphor settles over them like a well-worn duster: insults and shrapnel alike now mostly bounce.

You or one ally within range gains a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

Path of the Cosmic Linguist only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Cosmic Linguist can learn or prepare it.

Mal: 'Rhino-adjacent. Emotionally AND ballistically.'

spells.name: Threshold Cloak
spells.description:
You are dressed in the moment just before a door opens. That moment is famously hard to hit.

You gain a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

From the Path of the Shadow Courier.

Mal: Nobody looks at a doorway. They look at what comes through it. Be the doorway.

spells.name: Threshold Vertigo
spells.description:
You convince the ground under one enemy's next step that it is briefly a threshold to somewhere five feet away and slightly lower.

One creature you can see within range must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it is knocked prone.

Path of the Dreamwalker only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Dreamwalker can learn or prepare it.

Mal: 'Missing the last stair, as a service.'

spells.name: Tied Up At The Moment
spells.description:
You observe, mildly, that the target seems tied up right now. The figure of speech takes this as instructions.

One creature you can see within range must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it is restrained until the end of its next turn.

Path of the Cosmic Linguist only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Cosmic Linguist can learn or prepare it.

Mal: 'The rope isn't real. Their schedule conflict, however, is now very literal.'

spells.name: Tuesday's Newspaper
spells.description:
You skim tomorrow's headline about the next sixty seconds. It's mostly weather and violence, but it's YOUR weather and violence.

You gain a +2 to initiative for the duration.

Path of the Wyrdlens Adept only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Wyrdlens Adept can learn or prepare it.

Mal: 'Spoilers: somebody makes a terrible decision in the next minute. The lens just tells you which body it happens to.'

spells.name: Understudy
spells.description:
One of your spare selves learns an ally's part and shadows them through the scene, stepping into the worst moments in their place.

One ally within range gains a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

Path of the Dreamwalker only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Dreamwalker can learn or prepare it.

Mal: 'The show must go on. Just not, technically, happening to you.'

spells.name: Unmasking Flash
spells.description:
One camera-flash of absolute accuracy. Disguises, glamours, and comfortable self-images all develop at once, in public.

Each creature of your choice in a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 1d4 psychic damage and is frightened until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and suffers no other effect.

Path of the Wyrdlens Adept only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Wyrdlens Adept can learn or prepare it.

Mal: 'Everybody looks like their ID photo for one second. No one has ever forgiven the lens for this.'

spells.name: Wall of My People
spells.description:
The names of everyone you're protecting settle over the ground like poured foundation. Allies inside stand behind all of them at once.

Each creature of your choice in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within range gains a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

From the Path of the Bulwark.

Mal: It's not a metaphor. It's masonry with a mailing list.

spells.name: Warm Milk Ultimatum
spells.description:
The Quiet Sun leans on one furious person with the entire warm weight of every nap they ever refused. It is not a suggestion.

One creature you can see within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it is charmed (it can't willingly take violent action) for the duration.

At the end of each of its turns, an affected creature repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Path of the Dreamwalker only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Dreamwalker can learn or prepare it.

Mal: 'You will be soothed. This is a stick-up. Hands where I can tuck them in.'

spells.name: Wayhound Companion
spells.description:
A hound made of every shortcut you've ever taken. It knows the way, and it knows how to hold a stranger's ankle about it.

One creature you can see within range must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 1d6 force damage and is restrained for the duration. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and suffers no other effect.

From the Path of the Shadow Courier.

Mal: Good boy. Technically a metaphor. Still a good boy.

spells.name: We Signed For Each Other
spells.description:
You read out the mutual-defense compact this ground remembers: everyone here has been vouched for by someone. Violence becomes a breach of a promise with witnesses.

Each creature of your choice in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within range must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it is charmed (it can't willingly take violent action) for the duration.

At the end of each of its turns, an affected creature repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Path of the Pactkeeper only. This is a Doctrine signature; only a character who walks the Path of the Pactkeeper can learn or prepare it.

Mal: 'Peer pressure, notarized.'

spells.name: Wide Angle
spells.description:
You stop looking at the fight and start looking at the whole frame — every line of fire a thread of light you simply stand between.

You gain a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

From the Path of the Wyrdlens Adept.

Mal: 'Can't hit the photographer. Union rules. Cosmic union, but still.'
